layout.title: Howden PRO FPX Series 22"-9' (0.71M-2.74M) | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: The Howden FPX Series cooling tower fans are energy efficient and deliver low-noise performance in temperatures from standard to extremely high.

bullets.text: Fitted to your application – gain a balance between low noise, cooling performance, and power consumption.
Requires little maintenance – the single-piece body of the FPX is made of fibre-reinforced polyester (FRP)
Damps mechanical vibration: the FRP blades offer vibration damping and good chemical resistance.
Simple to assemble – FPX fans come with a tapered bushing connection as well as clear technical documentation
Highly convenient – get a complete FPX cooling unit package (including fan casing, drive, and entire suspension) all from one source
Applications – Field-erected cooling towers, packaged cooling towers, air-cooled condensers (ACC) and air cooled heat exchangers (ACHE)
